opportunities.point: Management projected the annual revenue guidance to be around INR600 crores to INR650 crores for the full year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Guidance for this quarter is to meet the yearly target that we have set for the full year, that would be somewhere around INR50 crores to INR55 crores of PAT and INR600 crores to INR650 crores of annual revenue." (concall transcript - 2026-03-01)

opportunities.point: Management provided an expected revenue of INR800 crores to INR900 crores for FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Should be probably doing around INR800 crores, INR900 crores with a PAT of around INR55 crores, INR60 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-03-01)

opportunities.point: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the upcoming wedding season.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted steady consumer demand ahead of the upcoming wedding season in the Occasional Wear segment.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Witnessing steady consumer demand ahead of the upcoming wedding season in the Occasional Wear segment, supported by ongoing optimisation of inventory mix with lightweight and budget-friendly offerings." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio" (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The current capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company is set to commence certain products in-house in the Daily Wear segment from Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "further the company is set to commence certain products in-house in Daily Wear segment from Q1 FY27 with dedicated infrastructure in place." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01) [Q1 FY27]

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that wholesale revenue declined by 12% year-on-year to INR70 crores for the quarter.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Wholesale revenue stood at INR70 crores, which has seen a decline of 12% Y-on-Y, while job work revenue approximately to INR2 crores, declining 46% Y-o-Y." (concall transcript - 2026-03-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S19/W8/O28/T9), led by 'Management projected the annual revenue guidance to be around INR600 crores to INR650 crores for the full year', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
